recipes.title: Chimichurri Steak Subs (12 meal-prep subs)

items.i: slices ultra-thin provolone or Swiss, halved
baguettes, each cut into 3 and hollowed out

steps: Season the steaks with the kosher salt and sear (or grill) to medium-rare. Rest, then slice into bite-size pieces.
Pulse the parsley, oregano, cilantro and garlic in a food processor, then blend in the olive oil, vinegar, salt and pepper; add water only if too thick.
Cut each baguette into 3 segments and hollow out the soft interior to cut calories and make room for filling.
Spread chimichurri inside and on top of each segment, fill with steak and lay in the halved cheese slices.
Toast or bake until the cheese melts and the bread is crisp. Wrap and refrigerate (or freeze) for the week.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros are the creator's, per sub. Save the bread you scoop out for breadcrumbs or croutons.
